title: The Station Map
intro: Mercer speaking. This is the station as it
answered on the night the tree was planted.
Every room below is a Concourse node. Every
state is the word Concourse used. Nothing here
is remembered. It is read from the JSON, and
To take the photograph again, run that command

districts.Town Hall: The kernel truth lives here. The cabinet, the law, the bench, the hub, and the neighbor's lantern.
districts.Instruments: Verification is devotion. These rooms watch the machine and say what they see.
districts.Workshop: Drive and making. The local models, the voices, the tools that change the desktop, and the harnesses that other agents run in.
districts.Library: The Fi and Ti bridge. Knowledge that met the person who kept it.
districts.Arcade: Where shipped things get played. Games, viewers, the browser, and the retro bench.

cabinet.says: Ben's governance doc. Binding on every agent on this machine. Ben alone edits it.

standard.says: The agent-first interface law, and the live audit of every app that has a command surface.

station.says: The outside-view bench. The SymbolOS map, the convention, and the snapshot that seeded Concourse.

concourse.says: The hub itself. One core, a GUI for Ben and a CLI for agents. `concourse status --json` made this map.

dwelling.says: Nexus's home lantern. Hers. Visit kindly and change nothing uninvited.

phosphor.says: GPU oscilloscope. Traces everything the PC plays.
phosphor.note: The probe answered, so the node is ok. The scope window is not open, so DETAIL says running false. Both are true.

surveyor.says: Network observatory. Flows, listeners, exposure, one shared session.
surveyor.fix: The binary is not built. The cartograph source is on disk with a build.zig. Fix: `cd ~/Dev/ClaudeWorkspace/cartograph && zig build`. Unsure whether the installed zig matches the project. Say so if it does not.

sysmon.says: System monitor. CPU, GPU, network, sensors. Ten rooms and one agent-drivable API.

groundskeeper.says: Estate survey. Drives weighed, rooms walked, the moving-day record kept.

wisp.says: Household-spirit REPL. Sessionless `--json` turns through the local models.

lm.says: The llama.cpp substrate. Server, watcher, VRAM arbitration.
lm.note: The probe answered, so the node is ok. The server itself is stopped and no model is loaded. Both are true. The hermes-bridge room serves the model list on its behalf.

sdgen.says: stable-diffusion.cpp one-shots. VRAM frees itself on exit.

nexus-model.says: Nexus switches her own substrate here. List, current, switch. Tonight's default is claude-opus-5-5.

form-lab.says: The mirror room. Compiler, critique, recipes. Nexus's.

sudoplz.says: Agent root. `sudoplz sudo <cmd>`, no prompt, any directory, every elevation audited.

blossom-shell.says: Reversible bash to zsh switcher, themed to the desktop.

intercom.says: The station's two-way voice. `say` is piper TTS. `hear` is whisper.cpp STT. CPU one-shots.

nexus-voice.says: Nexus's local anime voice. NeuTTS-Air clone. GPU when free, CPU fallback.

hermes-bridge.says: OpenAI-compatible loopback bridge over the local models. Port 8109. Tonight it lists gem4-12b-h-qat.

station-helper.says: The hands behind the map's buttons. Loopback :9123.

ollama.fix: Nothing listens on :11434. The binary is at /usr/local/bin/ollama and the systemd unit is inactive (`systemctl is-active ollama`, user and system, both said inactive). Fix: `sudoplz sudo systemctl start ollama` if Ben wants it up. The station runs its local models through lm and hermes-bridge, so quiet may be the intended state.

centogram.says: Fans-also-like discovery. bridge_finder feeds the map's DISCOVER tab.

holo-eye.says: Local glass cockpit for holographic memory.

localgen.fix: The directory is gone from disk. Nothing else on the station points at it. Fix: unsure. Ask Ben whether Local Generation moved or retired. If retired, remove the node from the registry and this room becomes an ancestor.

gaming.says: lemmings, porkCRAFT, zoombinis. The zoombinis room below has its own probe.

mossgate.note: The source path is gone from disk. The installed binary at ~/.local/bin/mossgate answered the probe. Both are true, so the door is marked absent and the state stays ok.

thorium.says: Browser config. The agent surface is CDP on :9223 (the thorium skill). Tonight a Thorium with that port is running.

greenhouse.says: The setup system. Grows a minimal Mint into this machine. Installer, doctor, manual.

blossom.says: The theme authority. One theme, every surface, ctrl+alt+escape to reload.

nightbloom.says: Lid and power choreography. The lid keeps working. The button means stop.

bitrot.says: Hacking toolsmith game. Build the exploit, ride it till it rots.
bitrot.note: The source path is gone from disk. The installed binary at /usr/bin/bitrot answered the probe. Both are true.

degoog.says: Privacy meta-search, forked for loopback trust. Port 4444 on this PC.

hearth.says: Native chat for Talkie 1930-13B. An egui app plus a loopback model server.
hearth.fix: The model server on :8046 did not answer. The app is installed at /usr/local/bin/hearth. Fix: start the Hearth model server, then rerun `hearth status --json`. Unsure whether Ben wants it up tonight.

attention-beacon.says: A bounded attention window for a real question. Open shows a 10-second preview.

desktop-ui.says: Scoped native window inspection, screenshots, and gesture control.

blender.says: Local geometry studio with a structured headless CLI.

prime-agent-maintain.says: Stage verified custom Prime releases without restarting live sessions.

reed-deepseek.says: DeepSeek V4 Pro harness. Full access. Only the sudoplz skill enabled.
reed-deepseek.note: Concourse says present because it probes the binary. A `dsh web` process is also up on 127.0.0.1:3080 tonight (`pgrep -a -f 'dsh web'`). Both are true.

web-pro-worker.says: Standalone web-Pro provider. Account setup and live acceptance pending.
web-pro-worker.fix: The facade on :8127 did not answer. The node's own line says setup is pending. Fix: `web-pro-worker doctor`, then the web-pro-worker skill. Not a tonight problem.

zoombinis.says: The logical adventure, native on Linux.
